summary: General action-effect negation-immunity 'Protection' primitive (Tamori Takeshi's 'effects of actions the target performs will not be negated'), completing the theme flagged in the wave 9 audit (Mirumoto Rokai, Tamori Takeshi, Tamori Tamoko). New Protection(Source,Duration) record and CardInstance.Protections, mirroring GrantedKeyword's Turn/Permanent duration convention, cleared at FinishTurn. Checked at the point a negation would otherwise apply (StalwartNegatesBow's own precedent) against both existing negation points (Effortless Counterattack's Additional-Action negation; the Attack-strength-negation Reaction). Generalized PendingAttack.SourceId (previously only two cards' own bespoke use) plus a new ActionPerformer helper so every Attack/Additional-Action now records its actual performer (an attached Item/Weapon resolves to its wielder). Wired Tamori Takeshi (personality-wave-11). Rokai and Tamoko's own second ability remain blocked -- they need a genuinely general 'negate one of an arbitrary action's own named effects' interrupt, a materially larger primitive left for a future pass. Filed a separate UI issue (#213) for Alfredo requesting a highlight/tooltip for permanently-granted keywords/abilities.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 130/130 core, 34/34 published, 8/8 deck-format. python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/content: 121/121. python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/collaboration: 43/43. tools/check.sh could not run end-to-end in this Windows Git Bash environment due to a pre-existing, unrelated glob-expansion bug in tools/env.sh's Godot-path detection; every check it would run was verified independently above.
remaining: Mirumoto Rokai and Tamori Tamoko's own second ability remain blocked pending a general 'before an arbitrary action resolves, negate one of its own named effects' interrupt -- not attempted this pass, noted in docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx.
